sources.title: TO FLOAT OR TO SWIM | NIKE - Spec Ad Made WITH AI!

quotes.text:
I recently dove into the world of AI to create a Nike Waterproof spec ad. I used MidJourney V.6 for the photo generation, Runway for the video motion, and Eleven Labs for the voiceover. The possibilities with AI are mind-blowing, and it's exciting to think about how this technology can empower artists like myself to create amazing projects without needing a Hollywood budget.

It's a bit scary to see how fast AI is advancing, but I believe it's going to revolutionize the creative industry. We're on the brink of a dramatic change, and I'm here for it. Embracing AI now means we can use it to our advantage before it's too late. This is just the beginning, and I can't wait to see what's next on this new adventure. 

Welcome to our latest video, where we dive into the cutting-edge world of AI animation, AI film, and AI video. In this episode, we showcase three incredible examples of how we've used MidJourney AI to create mesmerizing images and then brought them to life using the innovative technology of RunwayML.

From the initial concept to the final animation, we take you through each step of the process, highlighting the seamless integration of these AI tools. Witness the transformation of static art into dynamic motion, as we explore the endless possibilities that AI brings to the realm of digital storytelling.

Whether you're a tech enthusiast, an artist looking to explore new mediums, or simply curious about the future of animation, this video is sure to inspire and amaze. Don't forget to like, comment, and subscribe for more content that pushes the boundaries of creativity and technology.

Anyway this Nike Commercial Spec Ad was inspired my last trip to New York City and I hope you enjoy!

sources.title: Volvo - For Life // AI generated spec commercial

quotes.text:
Idea, prompting, post-production by me. This is a fan-made spec ad and not an official Volvo advertisement.

This is a test for trying out the RunwayML Gen-3 Alpha model for commercial purpouses.
All the shots are generated with RunwayML using text-to-video, some small details were retouched in AE after the edit was done (logo, license plate, or if I really liked a shot but there were two cars present, etc).

Altogether I spent less than 24 hours working on this video - Gen3 is only out since 1.5 day ago - this includes generating the clips, selecting them, editing them to a coherent story, retouching and sound design.

Is this a big step-up from Gen-2? Definitely! Gen-2 was a great experiment but Gen-3 is something that will change the industry. Pricing wise some people say it's expensive but I think if you go for the unlimited plan it's worth the money.

I just can't wait for the feature updates including image prompting and director mode!
